subject: Governance volume obscures operational incidents
recommendation: Keep canonical REPORT-INFRA destination; consolidate per operation when allowed, use a compact current-incidents view and avoid duplicate correction/resolution mentions. Channel move/permission change is not authorized by this audit.

subject: RC/canary incorrectly labeled stable Hermes update
recommendation: Use official release metadata and runtime ancestry; separate stable/prerelease/main; dedupe actionable target before calling the model. Preserve owner latest-main update semantics; do not claim main has no delta.

subject: Daily OAuth report assumes GPT5.6 while all active profiles use GPT6.1-sol
recommendation: Render actual models/provider and expose warning reason; separate policy mismatch, historical model usage, missing billing metadata and confirmed non-subscription usage. Do not turn unknown metadata or changed model into a billing claim.

subject: Recent planned host reboot blamed on weekly Monarx update
recommendation: Audit-backed maintenance/boot attribution first, one grouped informative event for authorized startup; keep unexpected/incomplete startup actionable. Journal cooccurrence with Monarx is not proof of its weekly update.

subject: Five separate SB restriction-monitor HTTP401 incidents despite bounded retries
recommendation: Investigate canonical auth renewal/session ownership; coordinate renewals under existing credential boundaries, distinguish transient refresh from truly expired session. Do not hide401 or increase retries blindly. Other SB consumers must keep identities/permissions isolated.

subject: Root-prefix watchdog covers48/51 MGS entries and not native Hermes jobs
recommendation: Unified read-only execution ledger for Linux/Hermes/timers with per-job completion/delivery predicates; reuse existing DR monitor rather than duplicate it. Daily financial collectors outside scripts prefix require explicit coverage. Validate timestamp-prefixed log formats and distinguish regex/JSON paths; isolated regex proof does not establish an observed production miss.

subject: Watchdog can suppress retry and discard recovery when webhook lookup yields no transport
recommendation: Use existing Zeus bot transport instead of repeated1Password webhook lookup; durable outbox and state transition only after confirmed delivery/readback. Preserve pending alert/recovery on unavailable transport.

subject: Resolver ledger has2error records for sources recovered by producer; plaintext FXfailure is ignored by own-bot/no-embed predicate

evidence.exact_resolver_failure_type: not recoverable from truncated stored exception

recommendation: Separate pending/retry/closed/error, preserve exception outcome instead of prompt argv, classify script-only alerts by validated producer/job identity. Add pagination for outage resilience; no observed50message overflow in this audited window. Never replay closed incidents for cleanup.

subject: Obsolete autocommit pause marker repeated17times; sensitive-name guardrail blocked auto-push in3episodes
recommendation: Lifecycle-managed maintenance exceptions and preflight check of new evidence paths; preserve secret guard and exact reviewed exclusions. No broad allowlist relaxation.

subject: Disk/load alarms were not all false positives
recommendation: Retain5minute critical health checks, add warning hysteresis and attributable growth/workload metrics; avoid new browser/UI/model polling. Measure post-upgrade real workload before claiming throughput gains.
